# Mago Labs: websites for trades and contractors

> Mago Labs builds custom, hand-coded websites for trades businesses (roofers, plumbers, electricians, HVAC, concreters, builders, landscapers, excavation, painters, tilers, glaziers and handymen) in Australia, the USA, the UK, Canada and New Zealand. Founder: Burhan Kapasi. Main site: https://www.magolabs.in/

## Key facts
- One-off price, no monthly fee: Australia A$1,149, USA US$799, UK £599, Canada C$1,149, New Zealand NZ$1,449.
- Includes up to 6 pages, all copy written, tap-to-call and quote form, Google basics (titles, schema, sitemap, Search Console), Google Business Profile setup and a year of edits and support.
- Free working preview within 48 hours; live in about 14 days. The client owns the domain, code and content.
- After year one: keep it running at no cost, pay an hourly rate for changes, or edit it with the built-in light CMS.
- Works remotely from India, in the client's time zone. Contact: burhan@magolabs.in, WhatsApp +91 90992 45605.

## Guides
- [How do tradies and contractors get found on Google Maps?](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/local-seo-for-trades/): How tradies and contractors get into the Google Maps 3-pack: Business Profile, reviews, service pages, citations and AI search. Plain, step-by-step.
- [The Google Business Profile checklist for tradespeople](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/google-business-profile-checklist/): Step-by-step Google Business Profile checklist for trades: service areas, categories, verification, reviews, posts, and how to avoid suspension in 2026.
- [What does a trade business website need to make the phone ring?](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/what-a-trade-website-needs/): The pages and features a tradie or contractor website needs to win jobs: tap-to-call, quote form, service pages, real photos, reviews, mistakes to avoid.
- [How much does a tradie website cost in Australia?](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/website-cost-australia/): A tradie website in Australia costs A$1,000 to A$3,500 from a freelancer, A$3,000 to A$10,000+ from an agency, or A$99 to A$400/month on subscription.
- [How much does a contractor website cost in the USA?](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/website-cost-usa/): A contractor website in the USA costs $17 to $46/mo DIY, $1,000 to $5,000 from a freelancer, or $5,000 to $15,000+ from an agency. 2026 cost guide.
- [How much does a website cost for a tradesperson in the UK?](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/website-cost-uk/): A UK tradesperson website costs £10 to £25/month DIY, £500 to £1,500 from a freelancer, or £3,000 to £12,000 from an agency. Honest 2026 price guide.
- [How much does a contractor website cost in Canada?](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/website-cost-canada/): A contractor website in Canada costs C$15 to C$60/month DIY, C$1,500 to C$7,000 from a freelancer, or C$3,000 to C$12,000 from an agency. 2026 guide.
- [How much does a tradie website cost in New Zealand?](https://trades.magolabs.in/guides/website-cost-new-zealand/): A tradie website in NZ costs NZ$15 to NZ$40/month DIY, NZ$1,000 to NZ$6,000 from a freelancer or small studio, or NZ$5,000 to NZ$15,000+ from an agency.
